description: Public-domain art and media search. Use when a task needs an image or artwork that is free to use: public-domain works from The Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Art Institute of Chicago, each with title, artist, date, medium, a full-size image URL, a thumbnail, the museum's page for the work, the licence the museum publishes and a ready-made credit line. Only items the museum itself flags as public domain are returned. Cost: 1 credit per call.

has_image.description: Only return items that have an image. On by default.

q.description: What to search the museum collections for.

source.description: all (default), met for The Metropolitan Museum of Art, or aic for the Art Institute of Chicago.

name: open_media_search
